Nk.bar_b_note: Warm meadow light and lush grass carry it, but barrels, crates, fire, wolf, rabbit and villagers pile into one cluster on a flat pale clearing (A) or dark muddy mat (B camp_bed), so no single prop reads at Palworld base-building clarity.

Wq.bar_b_note: The purple storm sky and rain set a Valheim-like mood, but the landmark is a cliff edge over a flat featureless plane (A) or a small stone planter of blue shards perched on that edge (B), with no sunken basin, black pool or glass floor to read as a place.

Io.bar_b_note: Storm grade, rain and glowing mushrooms carry the mood, but the glass reads as flat pale triangles on a purple cloth-like slab (A) or a pale crystal cluster stood behind the mushrooms without rooting into the rock (B), short of shipped-game finish.

Sd.bar_b_note: B's banded black-and-yellow hooded serpent has a strong standing silhouette but floats off the floor in an upright S-curve in faint mid/end, while A's noisy mottled gold texture turns the coils into a muddy lump, so neither holds the owner's creature bar.

Eb.bar_b_note: A clean, appealing elder villager with a readable face, big expressive eyes, white hair, green vest and scarf in the natural palette sits at Palworld character finish, though it is a little more cartoon than the naturalistic creatures.

Ww.bar_b_note: The ram's standing model matches the owner's Stormcapra bar, but A's faint collapses into a faceless fleece sack and B's hit react barely moves and its faint mid/end stretch into a smeared, half-lifted black-and-white mess, which breaks the finish.

Yo.bar_b_note: B's timber frame with diagonal brace, plank cap and stone footing finally reads as built, but the flat untextured tan infill and the thin, isolated, outhouse-door proportions still fall short of Palworld base pieces, and A is a blown-out white card.

Xk.bar_b_note: A's blue crystal clusters and cyan glowmoss read as Stormwood glass and moss, but they are small, alike in silhouette (crown is just a larger stormglass) and sit on a uniform dark moss carpet under flat light; B's brown boulders with paper-flat shards and a green blob read as generic placeholders.

Eo.bar_b_note: B's tall yellow speed cap and broad orange wild cluster separate clearly and sit in the grass, but the brown blocky rocks and plain green slope read more as a generic meadow than Cloudreach's bright sky and pale stratified stone, and A's pickups are small and look alike apart from colour.

top_changes.change: Re-author faint and hurt poses so creatures stay grounded and intact: no floating serpent (Sd B faint mid/end), no smeared or stretched skinning (Ww B faint), and the face stays visible in collapse (Ww A).

Build the Stormwood glass landmarks into the terrain: a sunken Glass Sink basin with a black pool and glass floor instead of a cliff edge over a flat plane, and spike clusters rooted in the rock with glass-tinted bases.

Give pickups, harvest nodes and camp props clear material cues and staging: emissive glass and copper on Stormwood nodes, a different silhouette for each variant, contact shadows and ground decals, and space between camp props, creatures and NPCs so each one reads at 30%.
